plan:
Update the Shipyard section and run view with the latest Frisson run, and add a way to explain what the Harbor Pilot does. Push when done. Run Shipyard so it can be seen in Claude Desktop.

Goal: The portfolio's Shipyard card and its run view (shipyard.html) show the latest real Frisson run, 2026-11-09T01-05-12 (single-crate view), and visitors can find out what the Harbor Pilot does, from a disclosure on the card and from a real review-guide excerpt on the run page.

plan_changes.change: Playwright not added to this repo; no owner question asked
plan_changes.why: The README says no dependencies. The browser check borrows the Playwright already installed in the crate-digger checkout.

plan_changes.change: Dev added phone CSS to the shipyard.html wrapper
plan_changes.why: The newer report template overflowed to 641px at 390px wide.

plan_changes.change: Card copy corrected from two made-up runs to three, outside the criteria
plan_changes.why: The harbormaster spec miscounted the invented runs, so the public copy said something false. No criterion covered it.
